en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a formal procession, likely from the early 20th century. Men in dark uniforms or suits are marching in organized rows, with some women visible among them. The street is unpaved and lined with trees, and there are spectators, including a young girl on the left side of the image. The bottom right features a logo and the text 'ARBEJDERMUSEET'. There is also some faint text at the bottom, possibly indicating the photographer or location.
